shared_rule.measurement_frame: lift_start_frame inferred from Shadow expert contact
shared_rule.target_hand_grasp_center: mean world position of five target-hand calibrated fingertips
shared_rule.object_bbox: move target-hand grasp center a bounded distance toward transformed object world-AABB center
shared_rule.shadow_tips: move target-hand grasp center a bounded distance toward the Shadow expert five-tip center at the same frame
shared_rule.temporal_application: zero before close_start, linear ramp through closing, constant correction from lift_start onward
shared_rule.changed_action_dimensions: wrist translation xyz only; rotation and all joint commands remain unchanged

range_reason.lower_bound: 1-1.5 mm is large enough to alter marginal contact but small relative to typical fingertip and collision-pad scales
range_reason.upper_bound: 3 mm is the largest previously confirmed beneficial Linker correction; larger 6/9 mm values already showed no additional gain
range_reason.xhand_shadow_cap: XHand is already close to the Shadow expert center, so its second point is capped at 2 mm to avoid nearly complete or overshooting alignment
range_reason.object_center_cap: object-center residual can exceed 17 cm, so only a local bounded correction is tested rather than full centering

selection_rule.within_hand: select at most one candidate only when success_count exceeds that hand's current A baseline; break ties by fewer regressions, then smaller correction
selection_rule.no_cross_hand_union: each hand freezes one global method; per-trajectory oracle union is forbidden
selection_rule.confirmation: the selected candidate must have positive paired net gain on frozen D before it may replace the current method
selection_rule.formal_1000: do not replay formal 1000 until all planned mechanism families are exhausted and one method per hand is frozen
